sender: Shibuya City Office, Family Register and Resident Records Division (渋谷区 戸籍住民課) / J-LIS
summary: The electronic certificates on your My Number Card expire on January 15, 2027. Renew them for free at Shibuya City Office before then.

actions.title: Renew the electronic certificates on your My Number Card
how: Go in person to the Family Register and Resident Records counter (戸籍住民課) at Shibuya City Office, weekdays 8:30 to 17:00
Bring your My Number Card, this notice, and your card PINs (a 4-digit number and a 6–16 character alphanumeric password)

consequences.text: After the expiry date you cannot use the card as a health insurance card, get certificates at convenience stores, log in to Mynaportal, or file online (e-Tax).

glossary.reading: でんししょうめいしょ
glossary.meaning: electronic certificate (digital ID stored on the card)
resident records division of the city office
period of stay (on your residence card)

warnings: Your My Number Card itself expires on the same day as your period of stay. If you extend your status, change the card's validity within 14 days.
